exposure: low prognosis according to the POSEIDON criteria
cohort: 17,893 patients under 35 years old undergoing IVF/ICSI cycles at a single reproductive medicine center from January 2016 to October 2020.  After screening, the study included 4,105 women in POSEIDON group 1, 1,375 women in POSEIDON group 3, and 11,876 women in the non-POSEIDON group.
finding: The POSEIDON group had lower cumulative live birth rates (CLBRs) after four IVF/ICSI stimulation cycles compared to the non-POSEIDON group, but there was no difference in the risk of most adverse birth outcomes between the groups.
birth_weight: Infants were assessed for low birth weight and macrosomia.
